headline: Nvidia has started a program that sets power and cooling requirements for suppliers that want their equipment used in its AI data center designs.
score_reason: Pool score 6, lowered by 2: the program was announced on 21 Sep 2026, so this 8 Oct piece is analysis of older news.
importance_line: Equipment suppliers and data center builders get a new Nvidia-set yardstick that could shape what they buy, but qualification covers single products, not whole sites, and rests on Nvidia's own requirements.
summary: Data Center Frontier reports that Nvidia's DSX Ready program, announced on 21 Sep 2026, first qualified Hitachi Energy, LG Energy Solution and Tesla for battery storage and LG Electronics, LiquidStack and Vertiv for liquid cooling units, with battery makers facing 12 tests that include following sudden swings in AI power demand. Qualification covers individual products only, so developers still have to design, connect and commission each site themselves.
notes: Read the full analysis. Program announced 21 Sep 2026; the 8 Oct article is a trade-press analysis with later partner news.
